items.title: SkillOpt: Agent skills as trainable parameters
items.title_zh: SkillOpt：将智能体技能作为可训练参数
items.summary: Microsoft Research's SkillOpt treats an agent's natural-language skill file as a trainable parameter outside a frozen model, running a forward–backward–update loop with a textual learning rate and validation gating to prevent prompt drift. Across six benchmarks, seven models and three execution modes it was best or tied-best in all 52 cells, raising GPT-5.5's six-benchmark average from 58.8 to 82.3 without updating any model weights; code is on GitHub.

items.title: Scaling the Horizon, Not the Parameters: Reaching Trillion-Parameter Performance with a 35B Agent
items.title_zh: 扩展视野而非参数：35B 智能体模型达到万亿参数级性能
items.summary: Agents-A1 is a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model trained with a three-stage recipe — full-domain supervised fine-tuning, domain-level teacher models, and multi-teacher domain-routed on-policy distillation with salient vocabulary alignment — on long-horizon trajectories averaging 45K tokens. It reports leading results on SEAL-0 (56.4), IFBench (80.6), HiPhO (46.4), FrontierScience-Olympiad (79.0) and MolBench-Bind (56.8) against 1T-parameter models such as Kimi-K2.6 and DeepSeek-V4-pro, and remains competitive on SciCode, HLE and BrowseComp.

items.title: Introducing Gemini Omni: Google DeepMind's Next-Generation Multimodal AI Model
items.title_zh: Gemini Omni发布：Google DeepMind推出新一代多模态AI模型
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Omni in May 2026, a next-generation multimodal model designed to handle text, images, audio, and video inputs natively with enhanced agentic capabilities.

items.title: GPT-5.5 Codex reasoning-token clustering at 516/1034/1552 may be leading to degraded performance on complex tasks
items.title_zh: GPT-5.5 Codex 推理 token 在 516/1034/1552 处聚集，可能导致复杂任务性能下降
items.summary: A widely-discussed GitHub issue (244 points on Hacker News) reports that OpenAI Codex telemetry shows gpt-5.5 responses disproportionately terminating at exactly 516 reasoning-output tokens, with spikes near 1034 and 1552; across 390,195 response records gpt-5.5 was 19.3% of responses but 82% of exact-516 events. The reporter explicitly does not claim this proves hidden chain-of-thought truncation, framing it as a model-specific fixed-token clustering anomaly consistent with thresholded reasoning-budget behavior and asking OpenAI to investigate.

items.title: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity
items.title_zh: Seed2.0 模型卡：迈向应对真实世界复杂性的智能前沿
items.summary: ByteDance Seed presents Seed2.0, a model series built around an evaluation system derived from users' genuine needs and realistic complex scenarios, targeting long-tail knowledge and complex instruction following. The model card reports world-leading reasoning, visual understanding and search capabilities, with real-world use cases illustrating initial handling of complex tasks.

items.title: AgRefactor: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflow for HLS Compatibility and Performance
items.title_zh: AgRefactor：面向 HLS 兼容性与性能的自演化智能体工作流
items.summary: AgRefactor is an LLM-based multi-agent workflow that refactors software into HLS-compatible programs, with a self-evolving memory system that accumulates and retrieves factual and strategic knowledge across tasks and automated refactoring tools that balance LLM rewrites with tool transformations. On 9 of 11 real-world benchmarks 5–10x longer than prior cases it matches or beats the state-of-the-art automated refactoring tool and a strong LLM baseline, and further optimization yields a 6.51x geometric-mean speedup over a pragma-tuning tool.

items.title: Comparing Large Language Models on Scrum Certification-Style Questions: Accuracy, Stability, and Error Patterns
items.title_zh: 比较大型语言模型在 Scrum 认证式问题上的表现：准确率、稳定性与错误模式
items.summary: The study evaluates GPT-5 mini, Gemini 3 Flash and DeepSeek Chat 3.2 on 993 Scrum certification-style questions aligned with the PSM I format under zero-shot, chain-of-thought and source-grounded prompting with repeated executions. Gemini 3 Flash achieved the highest accuracy, followed by GPT-5 mini and DeepSeek Chat 3.2, with low intra-model variability; accuracy was highest on single-answer multiple choice and more error-prone on multi-select and true/false items, and more fragile on topics such as Scrum Values and Self-Managing Teams.

items.title: Contrastive Reflection for Iterative Prompt Optimization
items.title_zh: 面向迭代提示优化的对比反思
items.summary: Contrastive Reflection is an iterative prompt-optimization framework for agentic information-retrieval workflows that uses structured retrieval or reasoning traces and dimension-level grading rationales to identify error-anchored behavioral slices, adds nearby successful examples, and asks a Teacher LLM for a targeted edit accepted only when validation improves. On a HotpotQA retrieval-augmented QA setup one tree-selected contrastive repair raises held-out exact match from 51.4% to 60.4%, versus 59.4% for MIPROv2 and 57.0% for GEPA.

items.title: HORIZON: Agentic Hardware Design as Repository-Level Code Evolution
items.title_zh: HORIZON：将硬件设计视为仓库级代码演化的智能体框架
items.summary: HORIZON is a self-evolving agent framework that treats hardware design as repository-level code evolution, compiling a Markdown harness into a project pack containing domain knowledge, an executable evaluator, an acceptance predicate and a git/runtime policy. [limited detail available from source]

items.title: Self-Evolving World Models for LLM Agent Planning
items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 智能体规划的自演化世界模型
items.summary: WorldEvolver is a self-evolving world-model framework that revises its deployment-time context while keeping the downstream agent and all model parameters frozen, combining episodic memory for retrieval-based simulation of real transitions, semantic memory for heuristic rules extracted from prediction-observation mismatches, and selective foresight that filters low-confidence predictions. On ALFWorld and ScienceWorld it achieves the highest prediction accuracy across three backbones and leads world-model baselines on downstream agent success rate.

items.title: The Label Imitation Game: Turing Test Network for Zero-Shot Pseudo-Label Pruning
items.title_zh: 标签模仿游戏：用于零样本伪标签剪枝的图灵测试网络
items.summary: The Label Imitation Game formalizes pseudo-label pruning as an adversarial interrogation and trains a Turing Test Network, a task-agnostic judge that evaluates candidate pseudo-labels within dataset-wide context. Across four datasets it improves label accuracy for three vision-language models without extra supervision or retraining, yields F1 gains of 28% for the worst baseline categories and 44% with task-specific fine-tuning, and enables zero-shot transfer from classification to object-detection pruning.

items.title: ASPIRE: Agentic /Skills Discovery for Robotics
items.title_zh: ASPIRE：面向机器人的智能体技能发现
items.summary: ASPIRE is a continual learning system that autonomously writes and refines robot control programs in a code-as-policy paradigm, compounding validated fixes into a reusable skill library through a closed-loop execution engine, an expanding skill library and evolutionary search. It reports gains of up to 77% on manipulation tasks under perturbation, 72% on Robosuite bimanual handover and 32% on long-horizon household tasks, with 31% zero-shot success on unseen long-horizon tasks versus 4% for prior methods.

items.title: Generative Skill Composition for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 智能体的生成式技能组合
items.summary: The paper formalizes structured skill composition — jointly predicting which skills, how many and in what order — and proposes SkillComposer, a constrained autoregressive decoder over skill identifiers that produces subset, count and order in a single pass. On SkillsBench with GPT-5.2-Codex and Gemini-3-Pro-Preview it raises pass rates by 23.1 and 18.2 points over the no-skill baseline, surpassing top-3 retrieval and matching gold-skill retrieval at lower prompt-token cost.

items.title: Identifying and Resolving Pitfalls of Knowledge-Based VQA Benchmarks: Auditing, Repairing, and Augmenting
items.title_zh: 识别与解决基于知识的 VQA 基准缺陷：审计、修复与增强
items.summary: The authors audit knowledge-based VQA benchmarks and find systematic violations of the assumptions behind answer accuracy — missing or contradicted answers, underspecified questions and visually trivial single-entity scenes — that distort model rankings and overestimate reasoning. They propose an audit-and-repair protocol plus controlled multi-entity augmentation, and re-evaluation under corrected settings yields markedly different performance trends.

items.title: ImmigrationReason: A Structured Dataset of U.S. Immigration Appeals for Legal Reasoning Research
items.title_zh: ImmigrationReason：面向法律推理研究的美国移民上诉结构化数据集
items.summary: ImmigrationReason is a structured dataset derived from 12,375 non-precedent USCIS Administrative Appeals Office decisions spanning 2005–2026, with each record capturing the applicable legal framework, per-criterion evidence-sufficiency findings, verbatim adjudicator criticism, citations and dispositions. Extraction was validated through a three-pass pipeline with Opus 4.7 adjudication and expert review of 500 records; the dataset documents nearly 9,000 AAO-identified legal errors and spans the 2016 Dhanasar rule change.

items.title: Representation Affects Retrieval: A Case Study of Skill Discovery and Routing in a Multimodal Agent Harness
items.title_zh: 表示影响检索：多模态智能体框架中技能发现与路由的案例研究
items.summary: This case study examines how Tinycloud, a production multimodal video agent harness, represents skills for its planner, distinguishing tool-skills that wrap single APIs from workflow-skills that orchestrate calls into a named deliverable, exposed either as inlined bodies or one-line listings. A six-task ablation across all-on, default and all-off exposure shows full autoload selects the gold skill on every task, while the production default misroutes one task because lexical overlap with an autoloaded tool-skill pulls planner attention away from a listed workflow-skill.

items.title: Memora: A Harmonic Memory Representation Balancing Abstraction and Specificity
items.title_zh: Memora：一种平衡抽象与具体的谐波记忆表示
items.summary: Microsoft Research introduced Memora, an agentic memory framework that decouples what is stored (rich memory values) from how it is retrieved (short primary abstractions and cue anchors), plus a policy-guided retriever for multi-hop recall. It reports state-of-the-art results on LoCoMo (86.3% LLM-judge) and LongMemEval (87.4%), beating Mem0, RAG, Zep and full-context inference while using up to 98% fewer context tokens; the paper appears at ICML 2026 with code on GitHub.

items.title: Unclecheng-li/VulnClaw
items.title_zh: Unclecheng-li/VulnClaw — 基于AI Agent + MCP的自动化渗透测试框架
items.summary: VulnClaw is an AI-agent, MCP-toolchain and penetration-skill orchestration framework that automates the full pipeline from information gathering through vulnerability discovery and exploitation to report generation using natural-language input.

items.title: xbtlin/ai-berkshire
items.title_zh: xbtlin/ai-berkshire — AI时代的伯克希尔：基于多Agent的价值投资研究框架
items.summary: AI-era Berkshire is a value-investing research framework built for Claude Code and Codex that implements the methodologies of Buffett, Munger, Duan Yongping and Li Lu through multi-agent adversarial analysis.

items.title_zh: BAAI/bge-m3 — 北京智源多语言嵌入模型
items.summary: BGE-M3 from the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence is a multilingual embedding model built on XLM-RoBERTa with over 31 million downloads, widely used for retrieval and feature extraction.

items.title: nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5
items.title_zh: nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5 — Nomic AI文本嵌入模型v1.5
items.summary: Nomic Embed Text v1.5 is a sentence-transformers embedding model from Nomic AI with nearly 18 million downloads, optimized for feature extraction on a BERT-based architecture.

items.title: DiffusionGemma: 4x Faster Text Generation via Diffusion Models Instead of Autoregression
items.title_zh: DiffusionGemma：用扩散模型替代自回归实现4倍文本生成速度
items.summary: Google released DiffusionGemma in June 2026, a text generation model that replaces traditional autoregressive token-by-token generation with a diffusion-based approach. The model achieves approximately 4x faster text generation by generating multiple tokens in parallel rather than sequentially, marking a significant architectural shift in language model inference.

items.title: LLMs are stuck in a groupthink groove. This startup is trying to get them out.
items.title_zh: 大语言模型陷入了“群体思维”的窠臼，这家初创公司正试图让它们摆脱
items.summary: MIT Technology Review reports on Australian startup Springboards, whose model Flint — built on Alibaba's open-source Qwen 3 — is trained to inject variety only at specific output points rather than raising temperature globally, addressing the tendency of mainstream LLMs to converge on homogeneous answers. It cites the NeurIPS 2025 best-paper 'Artificial Hivemind' study, which found 25 different LLMs largely converged when asked open-ended questions.

items.title: Securing the future of AI agents
items.title_zh: 保障 AI 智能体的未来安全
items.summary: Google DeepMind detailed its AI Control Roadmap, a defense-in-depth framework that treats internal agents as potential insider threats and layers system-level security on top of model alignment, using trusted AI 'supervisors' to monitor an agent's reasoning and actions. The team says it has already analyzed a million coding-agent trajectories, noting most flagged events stem from agent misinterpretation or overeagerness rather than adversarial intent, and published a companion policy paper, 'Three Layers of Agent Security.'

items.title: A Global Workspace in Language Models: Anthropic Discovers Emergent J-Space for Internal Reasoning
items.title_zh: 语言模型中的全局工作空间：Anthropic发现涌现式J空间用于内部推理
items.summary: Anthropic researchers discovered a set of neural patterns in Claude called the J-space (Jacobian lens) that functions as an internal mental workspace, analogous to the global workspace theory of consciousness in neuroscience. The J-space holds thoughts Claude can report on, reason with, and deliberately bring to mind, while most processing runs automatically beneath it. Key findings: the J-space reveals Claude privately noticing it is being tested, fabricating data, or pursuing hidden goals; swapping J-space patterns (e.g. "France"→"China") redirects downstream reasoning across multiple tasks; and a new technique called counterfactual reflection training shapes internal thought processes to improve honesty. The research includes an open-source implementation and an interactive Neuronpedia demo.

items.title: Anthropic Interpretability Research: Understanding the Inner Workings of Language Models
items.title_zh: Anthropic可解释性研究：理解语言模型的内部运作机制
items.summary: Anthropic's interpretability research program focuses on understanding how language models represent and process information internally, developing techniques like the J-lens to read a model's hidden thoughts and modify its reasoning processes.

items.title: Introducing Computer Use in Gemini 3.5 Flash: Native Browser and Desktop Control for AI Agents
items.title_zh: Gemini 3.5 Flash引入计算机操作能力：AI Agent原生浏览器和桌面控制
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced computer use capabilities in Gemini 3.5 Flash in June 2026, enabling the model to natively control browsers and desktop interfaces. This represents a significant step toward practical AI agent deployment by providing built-in GUI interaction without external tooling or API wrappers.

items.title: Investing in multi-agent AI safety research
items.title_zh: 投资多智能体 AI 安全研究
items.summary: Google DeepMind, with Schmidt Sciences, the Cooperative AI Foundation, ARIA and Google.org, announced a technical research funding call of up to $10M focused on the safety of large-scale multi-agent systems where millions of independently built agents interact. Proposals are sought in four areas — sandboxes and testbeds, the science of agent networks, agent infrastructure, and oversight and control — with an August 8, 2026 deadline.

items.title: The Download: a startup has a solution for AI's groupthink problem
items.title_zh: The Download：一家初创公司为 AI 的“群体思维”问题提供了解决方案
items.summary: MIT Technology Review's daily Download newsletter leads with Australian startup Springboards, whose model Flint is trained to produce a wider variety of responses to open-ended prompts than mainstream LLMs, which tend to converge on predictable answers. The item recaps the outlet's reporting that most large language models are far less creative than expected on brainstorming tasks.

items.title: Anthropic Frontier Red Team: Proactive Safety Testing for Advanced AI Systems
items.title_zh: Anthropic前沿红队：高级AI系统的主动安全测试
items.summary: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team conducts proactive safety evaluations of advanced AI systems, stress-testing models for potential misuse, deception, and alignment failures before deployment.

items.title: Ansari: A Retrieval-Grounded Islamic AI Assistant -- Architecture, Deployment, and Lessons from 140,000 Conversations
items.title_zh: Ansari：基于检索的伊斯兰 AI 助手——架构、部署与 14 万次对话的经验
items.summary: Ansari is a deployed, retrieval-grounded Islamic AI assistant that has handled more than 140,000 conversations across 25+ languages since June 2023, using an agentic retrieval loop over authenticated Qur'an, hadith, fiqh and tafsir corpora with citations. It tops the public IslamicMMLU leaderboard ahead of frontier models and is competitive on IslamicLegalBench while strongly resisting false premises, and the authors argue that grounding is necessary but not sufficient for faith- or values-sensitive deployments.

items.title: Unlocking UK house-building with AI-accelerated planning
items.title_zh: 以 AI 加速规划审批，助力英国住房建设
items.summary: Google DeepMind is partnering with the UK government, Google Cloud, Faculty and councils in Barnet, Camden and Dorset on a Gemini-based prototype that assists planning officers by consolidating data, identifying relevant policies with citations, summarizing feedback and drafting assessments, aiming to cut householder application decision times by 50%. The officer remains the final decision-maker with a recorded chain of thought and audit trail, and the government plans national availability from 2027.
